tools.name: get_similar_offers
tools.description: Find current offers similar to an offer returned by Dajsve. Useful for comparison before the user opens a merchant link.

offerId.description: Opaque offer identifier returned by Dajsve tools.

limit.description: Maximum number of alternatives, from 1 to 20.

tools.name: search_offers
tools.description: Search current offers aggregated by dajsve.com. Use Croatian search terms. Returns Dajsve offer details and a clickUrl that takes the user to the original merchant offer.

query.description: Croatian free-text search query. Leave empty only when requesting newest, popular or best-discount offers.

categories.description: Optional category IDs, names or URL slugs.

latitude.description: Optional latitude used together with longitude and radiusKm.

longitude.description: Optional longitude used together with latitude and radiusKm.

radiusKm.description: Optional search radius in kilometres, from 1 to 300.

sort.description: Sort: relevance, newest, popular, best_discount, price_asc, price_desc or discount_desc.

limit.description: Maximum number of offers to return, from 1 to 20. Default is 10.

tools.name: get_offer
tools.description: Get full details for one Dajsve offer and a small set of current alternatives. Use the offerId returned by search_offers.

offerId.description: Opaque offer identifier returned by Dajsve tools.

similarLimit.description: Number of similar offers to include, from 0 to 10.
